value.text: One of the large landmasses of the earth.
Demarcated areas of the earth that are homogeneous in terms of natural, historic, economic, political, or cultural characteristics that distinguish them from other areas.
A geographic region is a spatial region whose boundaries are typically defined against some material frame of reference (like the earth).
